name: blotato-brand-content
title_zh: 先出参考图再动视频，每步等你点头的品牌内容流水线
tagline_zh: 给品牌做图做视频最怕手一滑就发出去。它先查 Blotato 余额和模板，排成一份可审的作业单。
tagline_en: It inspects live Blotato credits and templates, builds a reviewable job plan, then generates one reference image.
desc_en: Plan and run approval-gated Blotato image and video generation for an approved brand profile, starting with Cinco H Ranch Naturals. Inspects live Blotato credits and templates, builds a reviewable job plan, generates one approved reference image, animates one approved image into video, and produces run audit evidence. Never publishes, schedules, or touches connected social accounts.
why_zh: 审批闸门卡在每一步之间，不是最后才拦。生成前先看真实余额和模板，避免白跑；产物带审计证据。
why_en: Approval gates sit between every step, not just at the end. It checks real credits and templates before generating, and every.
limit_zh: 只认已批准的品牌档案，目前仅 Cinco H Ranch Naturals 一套；只生成一张参考图和一段视频。
limit_en: Only approved brand profiles, currently just Cinco H Ranch Naturals. Generates one reference image and one video — no batch, no publishing, no.
